notes.title: Submerged: Hidden Depths - Featured in the MIX.
notes.content:
[h1] Submerged: Hidden Depths is featured in the MIX 10th Anniversary Showcase on Steam .[/h1]


[previewyoutube=fYZ8ksfXQ-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Miku and Taku are back!

This week Submerged: Hidden Depths features in the MIX 10th Anniversary Showcase on Steam! 

Time has passed and a lot has happened to Miku and Taku. The new game brings a new city to explore, a mystery to unravel, collectables to find and items to unlock.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614270

We can't wait for fans of Submerged to return to the world and experience the next chapter in Miku and Taku's story. Sit back, relax and watch the sunset. Explore and discover at your own pace.

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mix10year

Andrew & the Uppercut Games Team

notes.title: Submerged Sequel set for March 10 release on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Set sail on March 10th as Submerged: Hidden Depths launches on Steam.[/h1]

[previewyoutube=7VoO1Hgb4_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in a breathtaking city gripped by a dark mystery, Submerged: Hidden Depths is an adventure exploration game that sees players climb the ruins of lost skyscrapers to uncover the tale of the sunken city, while taking in its beauty and tranquility. Protagonists Miku and Taku have their own history with the darkness and whilst one wants to use it for good, the other fears it will tear them apart.

[h2]Wishlist now and help us make a splash on launch day! [/h2] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614270

We can't wait for fans of Submerged to return to the world and experience the next chapter in Miku and Taku's story. 

Andrew & the Uppercut Games Team

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Hidden Visions
notes.content:
The Hidden Visions update adds a new treasure hunt to the post-campaign Explore mode. What are these peculiar, pulsating plants and where will they lead Miku and Taku next? Follow the trail to find out!

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/55704020e4b06ce94faeecbd/1627615669513-7B02O34071KPLT4E28AA/Steam+Update+1.1+Banner.gif?format=750w[/img]

[h3]Additional Update Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unreal Engine Upgrade supports newer hardware.
[*] 4K Monitor support.
[*] Improved World Optimization and Level LODs.
[*] Various Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Submerged: Hidden Depths comings soon to Steam![/h2]
You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614270/Submerged_Hidden_Depths/]Wishlist Submerged: Hidden Depths[/url] to be notified when it is released.

Check out the Store page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614270/Submerged_Hidden_Depths/

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
Bug fix patch:

- Fixed a bug where you could be stuck on a plank after loading a save game.
- Fixed a few remnants that would just disappear.
- Fixed telescope mode leaving you in a spinning boat if you were turning whilst entering telescope mode.
- Fixed black ledges in low detail mode.
- Fixed a bunch of places you could fall off buildings.
- Removed the refraction from the raindrops shader. Should fix inverted rain drops on some GPUs.
- Unlock remnant image after explore mode if not found during campaign.
- Fixed Taku's bandage being missing during fire lighting cutscene.
